name: Michael Anton

lean.basis: Author of the pro-Trump essay "The Flight 93 Election" (2016); served in both Trump administrations (National Security Council spokesman 2017–2018; State Department policy planning director 2025); senior fellow at the Claremont Institute.

sources.title: Michael Anton — US Department of State

current_role: Jack Roth Senior Fellow in American Politics, Claremont Institute (former State Department policy planning director)
summary: Michael Anton wrote "The Flight 93 Election" (2016) under the pen name Publius Decius Mus, a defining case for Trump among conservative intellectuals. He was the National Security Council's communications chief in 2017–2018 and, under Secretary Marco Rubio, the State Department's director of policy planning from January to September 2025, when he led expert-level talks with Iran. Politico reported he left frustrated with Sergio Gor; the State Department denied any friction.
